title: Restore The Array
description: Count the number of ways to restore an array from a string s and integer k such that all numbers are between 1 and k and contain no leading zeros.
pseudocode:
1: n = s.length, dp = new Array(n + 1).fill(0)
2: dp[n] = 1
3: for i = n - 1 down to 0:
4:   if s[i] == '0' continue
5:   num = 0
6:   for j = i to n - 1:
7:     num = num * 10 + parseInt(s[j])
8:     if num > k break
9:     dp[i] = (dp[i] + dp[j + 1]) % 1000000007
10: return dp[0]

steps.note: Initialize DP array of size n+1 with zeros.
Base case: one way to represent an empty suffix.
Extract substring '0', skip due to leading zero rule.
